comments.author: @dreamssundial3051
comments.text:
I'm from Taiwan, and I was deeply touched by this video.

Thank you for uncovering so many unique aspects of Taiwan that even I had never really noticed before. When you showed the temple with incense curling through the air, I found the image unexpectedly beautiful. I don't even know exactly why it moved me so much.

It made me realize that, just as you said, religion is deeply woven into our everyday lives. I have grown up seeing temples, incense, and these traditions around me, but I had never really stopped to look at them this way before.

Thank you for helping me see something so familiar from a new perspective.😊

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
